groups.root_cause: While the invocation is running, tool calls that never get a result are left out of the repetition count, so repeated unresolved calls go on with no limit.
One call that never returns blocks the in-order processing at line 206, so later identical calls that did complete are never counted as a loop.
The bounded window at line 180 can drop unresolved calls before they are counted, so the session-end check misses the loop too.
